svg.aria-label: Proof runs: Real agent numbers from proof runs on 2026-10-11, rescored and renormalized. "Saved" compares each arm with vanilla (no server); positive means fewer. Range = min .. max over repeats. Caveats: Small n, fixed fixtures (L1 sample project, L4/L6 this repo, I-tasks the generated fixture), one day. GLM caching: GLM caches tool definitions across sessions with no off switch, so its uncached counts leave out that prefix. Opus is a smoke check: n=2 per task and arm (one cold, one warm), no guided arm. The guided DeepSeek miss is an L6 timeout (300 s). Older runs: Agent runs before 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC told every arm to use the built-in file tools. They do not show the server in use
